comment: Copy into <workspace>/.devin/mcp_config.local.json (the machine-local layer, auto-gitignored) and substitute {{COORD_ROOT}} (the clone's absolute path) and {{WORKSPACE}} (the workspace's absolute path). One `agent-coord-<name>` entry per roster member — each is its own stdio process, pre-bound by AGENT_COORD_BOUND_AGENT, so the name it serves can neither be claimed by nor mistaken for a teammate. There is no generic `agent-coord` entry: an unbound server TOFU-locks to whatever name calls it first, which is useless on a shared bus — a tab that is not on the roster has no entry, and that is the point.
